workflows.name: Website Discovery Import
workflows.description: Category-first Playwright discovery of a vendor website: render homepage -> AI site analysis -> category tree cache -> user category selection -> recursive scraping per selected node -> AI classification and extraction -> normalization -> minimal product picker -> Discovery Session.
workflows.start_state: Vendor added with website URL; no cached category tree
workflows.success_state: Discovery Session populated with normalized candidate items extracted from selected vendor categories.
system_actions: Send rendered DOM to AI extraction capability
AI page classification and structured extraction
Normalize vendor terminology into unified schema
Collect candidate items into Discovery Session
user_actions: Select categories and subcategories to import

workflows.name: PDF Catalog Import
workflows.description: Upload a vendor PDF catalog -> OCR -> AI extraction of clickable items -> normalization -> Discovery Session.
workflows.start_state: Vendor exists; PDF catalog file available
workflows.success_state: Discovery Session populated with clickable catalog items extracted from the PDF.
system_actions: Send structured content to AI extraction capability
user_actions: Review extracted candidate items in Discovery Session
evidence_refs: System-References/PRD Docs/Source Blender PRD.md#PDF Catalog Import

workflows.name: Discovery Session Review and Import
workflows.description: Staging review of candidate items with search, filtering, multi-select, preview, edit, bulk import, ignore, and archive before any item becomes a catalog item.
workflows.start_state: Discovery Session contains candidate items (New, Updated, Ignored, Archived states)
workflows.success_state: Selected candidates become fully editable Universal Catalog Items; ignored items are archived.
system_actions: Maintain candidate states (New, Imported, Updated, Ignored, Archived)
Detect duplicates and conflicts against existing catalog
Create Universal Catalog Items on import

workflows.name: Vendor Management
workflows.description: Create, edit, archive vendors; manage vendor website, contacts, notes, categories, and sync history.
workflows.success_state: Vendor record exists and is available as an import source and catalog attribution.

workflows.name: Workspace Management
workflows.description: Manage multi-tenant workspace settings including AI settings and branding.
workflows.success_state: Workspace is configured, can host vendors, catalog, and AI provider settings.

workflows.name: AI Provider Configuration and Capability Routing
workflows.description: Register AI provider adapters (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama, LiteLLM, LM Studio, local models, custom endpoints); route AI capabilities to providers without changing business logic; monitor provider health; handle retries and fallbacks.
workflows.start_state: Workspace exists with no AI providers configured
workflows.success_state: AI capabilities route to configured providers; platform runs if zero providers are configured (AI features degrade gracefully).
system_actions: Register and store providers via adapter architecture
Route AI requests by capability (catalogExtraction, semanticSearch, etc.)
Manage retries, fallbacks, and health checks
Degrade gracefully when no providers configured
evidence_refs: System-References/PRD Docs/Inference Layer summary.md#AI Provider Adapter Pattern

workflows.name: Universal Catalog Management
workflows.description: Manage Universal Catalog Items (products, services, rentals, labor, manufacturing, installation) with manual entry, editing, search, filtering, and bulk actions.
workflows.start_state: Workspace exists with empty or partial catalog
workflows.success_state: Catalog contains curated, edited Universal Catalog Items.

workflows.name: Pricing Engine Application
workflows.description: Apply fixed pricing, percentage markup, or manual pricing to catalog items; formula pricing deferred to future.
workflows.start_state: Catalog items have a vendor cost but no selling price or margin
workflows.success_state: Catalog items have a selling price and margin computed via the selected pricing mode.
user_actions: Select pricing mode per item or in bulk

workflows.name: Flyer Builder
workflows.description: Drag-and-drop editor composing products and services into a flyer with branding and templates; export to PDF or PNG.
workflows.start_state: Catalog contains items usable in a flyer
workflows.success_state: Flyer PDF or PNG exported using owned catalog data and workspace branding.

workflows.name: Quote Builder
workflows.description: Compose mixed catalog items into a quote with quantities, taxes, discounts, and shipping; export as PDF.
workflows.start_state: Catalog contains items usable in a quote
workflows.success_state: Quote PDF exported using owned catalog data.
system_actions: Compute totals with taxes, discounts, shipping

workflows.name: Collections Management
workflows.description: Create mixed item collections, reusable packages, bulk editing, and export support.
workflows.success_state: Collection of mixed items created, optionally reused across flyers and quotes.

workflows.name: Analytics Review
workflows.description: View vendor spend, monthly spend, margin, top vendors, category, quote, and catalog growth analytics.

workflows.name: Vendor and Document Memory Sync
workflows.description: Re-import a source and detect new, removed, price-changed, and description-changed items; review before applying changes; maintain synced version history per vendor and document.
workflows.start_state: Vendor or document already imported at least once
workflows.success_state: Changes detected, reviewed, and applied; vendor/document version history updated.
system_actions: Compare current import against prior version
Diff new, removed, price-changed, description-changed items

workflows.name: Manual Entry
workflows.description: First-class manual creation of products, services, rentals, labor, manufacturing, and installation without any automated source or AI provider.
workflows.start_state: Workspace exists; no source available (or user chooses manual entry)
workflows.success_state: Universal Catalog Item created and added to the catalog with full editability.

failure_or_recovery_hints.failure: Playwright cannot render or traverse vendor site
failure_or_recovery_hints.recovery: Log site into vendor memory as unscrapeable; offer manual entry fallback; flag for Stage 2 technical validation.
Allow user correction of category tree; fall back to minimal product picker with editable candidates.
Notify user; request OCR pass or manual entry; record as sync history failure.

failure_or_recovery_hints.failure: No AI providers configured but AI capability requested
failure_or_recovery_hints.recovery: Degrade gracefully; skip AI enrichment; allow manual-only workflow.
Use configured fallback provider; surface health in UI; queue retries.

failure_or_recovery_hints.failure: Duplicate or conflict detected during validation
failure_or_recovery_hints.recovery: Surface to user in Discovery Session; allow merge or ignore; record conflict in sync history.

stage_decision_brief.recommended_direction: Build Source BlendR as an AI-agnostic Vendor Intelligence Platform: multi-tenant workspaces, Playwright-first website discovery, PDF catalog extraction, Discovery Session staging before import, Universal Catalog Items (products, services, rentals, labor, manufacturing, installation), AI Provider Adapter Architecture with capability routing, background workers, and deferred future features per the PRD.
alternatives_considered: Single AI provider only (rejected: violates AI-agnostic locked principle)
Auto-import without Discovery Sessions (rejected: violates discovery-before-import locked principle)
Product-only catalog (rejected: violates Universal Catalog Items locked decision)
Plug-in marketplace architecture (rejected: explicitly out of scope in Inference Layer summary)
key_decisions: Playwright is the locked web discovery engine
AI is provider-agnostic via adapter architecture and capability router
Discovery Sessions always gate catalog imports
Universal Catalog Items replace Product-only schema
Manual entry is a first-class workflow; platform runs with zero AI providers
Background workers handle scraping and AI processing
PDF imports are equal in status to website imports
Flyer and Quote Builders are should-have; may be trimmed or deferred to protect MVP risk

assumptions.assumption: Playwright + AI-assisted site analysis handles the majority of target-market vendor sites.
Target users value provider independence and owned catalog data.
Discovery Sessions are accepted as friction-positive vs auto-import competitors.
Universal Catalog Items cover the target market without forcing partial re-architecture.
Background workers keep the UI responsive for expected scrape/AI durations without a streaming UI.

risks.description: Playwright reliability across diverse vendor sites
Target market too small or unwilling to pay

downstream_impact: Stage 2 must validate differentiation hypotheses, market demand, and technical assumptions (Playwright reliability, OCR/AI extraction quality, Universal Catalog schema coverage).
Stage 3 must lock adapter interface, capability router contract, validation engine contract, multi-tenancy isolation boundary, and queue/timeout strategy.
Stage 4 must validate Discovery Session UX and catalog browsing UX.
Stage 5 slices import-to-catalog flow, adapter architecture, and catalog as launch-critical; flyer/quote as should-have.
Stage 6 acceptance criteria must include AI extraction-quality tests per capability and validation engine tests.
